# Wildflower Cases

> > Wildflower Cases offers handmade, limited-edition protective cases and accessories for iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, AirPods, and other devices with unique artistic designs.

Wildflower Cases specializes in trendy, handmade phone cases and tech accessories featuring distinctive patterns like florals, animal prints, polka dots, and designer collaborations. The brand creates protective cases for the latest iPhone models (iPhone 17, 16, 15 series), Samsung Galaxy devices, AirPods, and accessories like screen protectors, charms, and AirTag cases.

## Key Topics

- iPhone cases (iPhone 17, 16, 15 series)
- Samsung Galaxy cases
- AirPods cases and AirPods Max covers
- Handmade protective cases
- Limited edition designs
- Designer collaborations (Sandy Liang, Nara Smith, Orebella)
- Screen protectors with bling/rhinestones
- Scratch-resistant materials
- Floral and animal print patterns
- Polka dot designs
- Pearl and embellished cases
- AirTag accessories
- Phone charms and keychains
- Final sale items
